activity_summary: At the last you said he never once asks her, and that she does it all. You said the parting line, and you told yourself to leave it in. You came in at half past two.

facets.activity: Said to leave the parting line in

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He never once asks her. She does it all

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Parting is such sweet sorrow. God. Leave it. Leave it in
